# Biomorphs
[bold]Biomorphs[/bold] are twisted masses of flesh, sinew and bone, built from the bodies of their victims and driven by a hunger for more.
## The Infestation - Biomorphs move as one, sharing a single hive and speaking without sound. - They grow their territory out of flesh: carpets of sobbing, pulsing sinew, twitching walls of fused bone, and throbbing [bold]flesh nests[/bold] that birth new horrors at irregular intervals. - Fleshy sacs and rotting biomass release clouds of toxic, infectious spores. - They come in many twisted shapes, from skittering severed heads to lumbering brutes with fists the size of a man's torso.
## Infection - Biomorphs spread through a dark, clotting [bold]venom[/bold] wrung from rotted flesh, and through their spores. Anyone who takes it into their body risks infection. - The infection is said to feel like a crawling heat under the skin. - It can be stopped. Cutting off the infected limb kills whatever is growing there, and a covertly produced [bold]experimental counteragent[/bold] of [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] origin purges it outright, at a price.
## Mimics The most feared biomorphs can [bold]assimilate[/bold] the helpless, absorbing them and stealing their shape. A mimic can walk back into a colony wearing a victim's face, and no one would know until it is too late.
## On the Frontier - Like the other horrors out there, biomorphs are not common knowledge. - Weyland-Yutani is known to keep samples of biomorph venom in its experiment crates. What the Company wants with it, it isn't saying.
